title: Building Custom Agents
text: vignette written beginners want build first graph-based agents LLMAgentR. already use built-functions like build_code_agent() build_researcher_agent(), custom agents let define workflow steps.

title: Building Custom Agents
text: state flows custom agent, define nodes edges, route conditions, generate Mermaid graph debugging documentation.

title: Building Custom Agents
text: custom agent small state machine: state: named list shared nodes. node: function function(state) returns named list update, make_command(goto = "...", update = list(...)). edge: transition one node next. entry_point: first node run. __end__: special terminal node. build build_custom_agent() compile_graph().

title: Building Custom Agents
text: first example two steps: route handler, write answer stop. notice: start uses make_command("answer") jump directly. answer returns normal named list update state. edge answer -> __end__ finishes execution.
code: library(LLMAgentR)  agent <- build_custom_agent(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) {       make_command("answer")     },     answer = function(state) {       query <- if (is.null(state$query)) "" else state$query       list(         answer = paste("You asked:", query),         handled = TRUE       )     }   ),   entry_point = "start",   edges = list(     c("answer", "__end__")   ),   default_state = list(handled = FALSE) )  result <- agent(list(query = "How do I build a custom agent?")) str(result)

title: Building Custom Agents
text: real workflows need routing. , one node sets state$route, conditional edges map route label target node.
code: library(LLMAgentR)  router_agent <- build_custom_agent(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) {       make_command("classify")     },     classify = function(state) {       q <- if (is.null(state$query)) "" else tolower(state$query)       route <- if (grepl("weather", q)) "weather" else "general"       list(route = route)     },     weather_handler = function(state) {       list(answer = "Routing to weather workflow.")     },     general_handler = function(state) {       list(answer = "Routing to general workflow.")     }   ),   entry_point = "start",   conditional_edges = list(     list(       from = "classify",       condition = function(state) state$route,       mapping = list(         weather = "weather_handler",         general = "general_handler"       )     )   ),   edges = list(     c("weather_handler", "__end__"),     c("general_handler", "__end__")   ) )  router_agent(list(query = "weather in Accra")) router_agent(list(query = "summarize this report"))

title: Building Custom Agents
text: Use compile_graph() want : runnable function ($run), graph artifacts ($graph, $mermaid).
code: library(LLMAgentR)  compiled <- compile_graph(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) make_command("classify"),     classify = function(state) {       q <- if (is.null(state$query)) "" else tolower(state$query)       list(route = if (grepl("weather", q)) "weather" else "general")     },     weather_handler = function(state) list(answer = "Weather path"),     general_handler = function(state) list(answer = "General path")   ),   entry_point = "start",   conditional_edges = list(     list(       from = "classify",       condition = function(state) state$route,       mapping = list(         weather = "weather_handler",         general = "general_handler"       )     )   ),   edges = list(     c("weather_handler", "__end__"),     c("general_handler", "__end__")   ),   subgraphs = list(     Router = c("start", "classify"),     Handlers = c("weather_handler", "general_handler")   ) )  cat(compiled$mermaid) out <- compiled$run(list(query = "weather tomorrow")) str(out)  # Optional PNG render (requires Mermaid CLI `mmdc`) # save_mermaid_png(compiled, file = "router_graph.png")

title: Building Custom Agents
text: Node returns non-list output: return named list make_command(...), bare string/number. entry_point typo: must match one names node_functions. Missing route mapping: condition(state) returns label found mapping, execution fails. path __end__: make sure every route eventually terminates.

title: Building Multi-Agent Teams
text: build_custom_multi_agent() creates supervisor-style teams : supervisor decides worker runs next, worker updates shared state, execution ends supervisor returns finish token (default "FINISH"). pattern useful want specialist agents (research, writing, QA) coordinate single router node.

title: Building Multi-Agent Teams
code: library(LLMAgentR)  supervisor_fn <- function(state) {   if (is.null(state$research_done) || !isTRUE(state$research_done)) {     return("Researcher")   }   if (is.null(state$draft_done) || !isTRUE(state$draft_done)) {     return("Writer")   }   "FINISH" }  workers <- list(   Researcher = function(state) {     old_log <- if (is.null(state$log)) character(0) else state$log     list(       research_done = TRUE,       findings = c("Customer churn is highest in month 2."),       log = c(old_log, "Researcher completed evidence gathering.")     )   },   Writer = function(state) {     old_log <- if (is.null(state$log)) character(0) else state$log     draft <- paste(       "Executive summary:",       paste(state$findings, collapse = " ")     )     list(       draft_done = TRUE,       draft = draft,       log = c(old_log, "Writer produced first draft.")     )   } )  team <- build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor = supervisor_fn,   workers = workers,   max_turns = 6L )  result <- team(list(log = character(0))) str(result)

title: Building Multi-Agent Teams
text: Workers can also compiled custom-agent objects (example compile_graph() build_custom_agent(..., output = "")).
code: research_worker <- compile_graph(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) {       old_log <- if (is.null(state$log)) character(0) else state$log       list(         research_done = TRUE,         findings = c("Retention drops sharply after onboarding."),         log = c(old_log, "Research worker graph completed.")       )     }   ),   entry_point = "start" )  writer_worker <- compile_graph(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) {       old_log <- if (is.null(state$log)) character(0) else state$log       list(         draft_done = TRUE,         draft = paste("Memo:", paste(state$findings, collapse = " ")),         log = c(old_log, "Writer worker graph completed.")       )     }   ),   entry_point = "start" )  team_with_compiled_workers <- build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor = supervisor_fn,   workers = list(     Researcher = research_worker, # uses research_worker$run internally     Writer = writer_worker   ),   max_turns = 6L )  result2 <- team_with_compiled_workers(list(log = character(0))) str(result2)

title: Building Multi-Agent Teams
text: Request output = "" get: run: runnable team function, graph: graph spec object, mermaid: Mermaid diagram text.
code: compiled_team <- build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor = supervisor_fn,   workers = workers,   output = "both",   direction = "LR" )  cat(compiled_team$mermaid)  # Optional: render PNG (requires Mermaid CLI `mmdc`) # save_mermaid_png(compiled_team, file = "multi_agent_team.png")

title: Building Multi-Agent Teams
text: can control team behavior : worker_error_policy = "return_to_supervisor": worker errors collected state$errors execution continues. worker_error_policy = "stop": stop immediately worker error. allow_repeat = FALSE: prevent worker running twice row alternatives exist. max_turns: hard cap worker turns.
code: resilient_team <- build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor = supervisor_fn,   workers = workers,   worker_error_policy = "return_to_supervisor",   allow_repeat = FALSE,   max_turns = 8L )

title: Language Model Agents in R for AI Workflows and Research
text: Create lightweight wrapper around call_llm() reuse. optionally provides verbose output:
code: call_llm(   prompt     = "Summarize the capital of France.",   provider   = "groq",   model      = "llama3-8b",   temperature = 0.7,   max_tokens = 200,   verbose = TRUE )  my_llm_wrapper <- function(prompt, verbose = FALSE) {   if (verbose) {     message("[my_llm_wrapper] Sending prompt to LLM...")   }    # Suppress console output but always return the response   response_text <- if (verbose) {     call_llm(       prompt     = prompt,       provider   = "openai",       model      = "gpt-4o",       max_tokens = 3000,       verbose    = TRUE     )   } else {     suppressMessages(       suppressWarnings(         call_llm(           prompt     = prompt,           provider   = "openai",           model      = "gpt-4o",           max_tokens = 3000,           verbose    = TRUE         )       )     )   }    if (verbose) {     message("[my_llm_wrapper] Response received.")   }    return(response_text) }

title: Language Model Agents in R for AI Workflows and Research
text: Alternatively, preconfigure LLM call one-liners:
code: my_llm_wrapper <- call_llm(       provider    = "openai",       model       = "gpt-4o",       max_tokens  = 3000,       verbose = TRUE )

what: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
title: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
text: Constructs LLM-powered agent generating, debugging, explaining, optimizing R code. **Two calling patterns supported**: **Builder pattern** – omit `user_input`. function returns         reusable coder-agent closure. Call closure         different queries whenever need code help. **One-shot pattern** – provide `user_input`. function executes         immediately returns result .

title: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
text: llm function accepts character `prompt` returns LLM response (optionally accepts `verbose`). system_prompt Optional system-level instructions override built-default prompt. user_input coding task/query (e.g., `"Write function filter NAs"`). **Default `NULL`** – omit obtain reusable agent. max_tries Maximum LLM retry attempts (default `3`). backoff Seconds wait retries (default `2`). verbose Logical flag show progress messages (default `TRUE`).

title: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
text: `user_input` `NULL`: function (coder-agent closure). Otherwise: list fields input original user query. llm_response LLM output (error message). system_prompt Prompt actually sent. success Logical; call succeed? attempts Number attempts made.

title: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
text: agent automatically retries failed LLM calls (exponential back-) always returns structured result.

title: Build an R Code-Generation Agent — build_code_agent
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 1)  Builder pattern – create a reusable coder agent ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ coder <- build_code_agent(   llm       = my_llm_wrapper,   # your own wrapper around the LLM API   max_tries = 3,   backoff   = 2,   verbose   = FALSE )  # Use the agent multiple times res1 <- coder("Write an R function that z-score–standardises all numeric columns.") res2 <- coder("Explain what `%>%` does in tidyverse pipelines.")  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2)  One-shot pattern – run a single request immediately ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ one_shot <- build_code_agent(   llm        = my_llm_wrapper,   user_input = "Create a ggplot2 bar chart of mpg by cyl in mtcars.",   max_tries  = 3,   backoff    = 2,   verbose    = FALSE ) } # }

what: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
title: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
text: Build reusable agent wiring user-defined node functions state graph. public extension point creating custom LLMAgentR workflows.

title: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
code: build_custom_agent(   node_functions,   entry_point,   edges = list(),   conditional_edges = list(),   default_state = list(),   checkpointer = NULL,   output = c("agent", "mermaid", "both"),   direction = c("TD", "LR"),   subgraphs = NULL,   style = TRUE )

title: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
text: node_functions Named list node functions. function takes `state` returns named list [make_command()]. entry_point Name start node (must exist `node_functions`). edges Optional list static edges. item can : - character vector length 2: `c("", "")`, - list `` ``. conditional_edges Optional list item contains: - `` (`node_name`), - `condition` (`condition_fun`), - `mapping` (`mapping_list`) named list label -> node. default_state Optional named list merged `state` missing keys. checkpointer Optional callback `function(state, current_node)` executed transition. output Output mode: - `"agent"` (default): return runnable agent function, - `"mermaid"`: return Mermaid text , - `""`: return list `run`, `graph`, `mermaid`. direction Mermaid direction used `output` includes Mermaid. subgraphs Optional named list subgraph groups Mermaid rendering. style Logical; include default Mermaid class styling.

title: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
text: - `output = "agent"`: function accepts `state` returns final state. - `output = "mermaid"`: Mermaid flowchart text. - `output = ""`: list `run`, `graph`, `mermaid`.

title: Build a Custom Graph-Based Agent — build_custom_agent
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ custom <- build_custom_agent(   node_functions = list(     start = function(state) make_command("classify"),     classify = function(state) {       if (grepl("weather", state$query, ignore.case = TRUE)) {         make_command("weather")       } else {         make_command("general")       }     },     weather = function(state) list(answer = "Routing to weather handler"),     general = function(state) list(answer = "Routing to general handler")   ),   entry_point = "start",   edges = list(c("weather", "__end__"), c("general", "__end__")),   output = "both",   subgraphs = list(     Router = c("start", "classify"),     Handlers = c("weather", "general")   ) )  cat(custom$mermaid) custom$run(list(query = "weather in Accra")) } # }

what: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
title: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
text: Build supervisor-routed multi-agent workflow, similar LangGraph team orchestration. supervisor chooses next worker setting `state$next` one worker names `FINISH`.

title: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
code: build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor,   workers,   finish_token = "FINISH",   max_turns = 10L,   allow_repeat = FALSE,   worker_error_policy = c("return_to_supervisor", "stop"),   default_state = list(),   checkpointer = NULL,   output = c("agent", "mermaid", "both"),   direction = c("TD", "LR"),   subgraphs = NULL,   style = TRUE )

title: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
text: supervisor Function accepts `state` returns: - worker name (character scalar), - list `next`, optionally additional updates. workers Named list workers. worker can : - function accepts `state` returns named list updates, - compiled custom-agent object callable `$run` function (  example [build_custom_agent()] `output = ""`   [compile_graph()]). finish_token Character label used supervisor terminate. max_turns Maximum worker turns forcing finish. allow_repeat Logical; allow worker twice row. worker_error_policy `"return_to_supervisor"` (default) `"stop"`. default_state Optional defaults merged incoming `state`. checkpointer Optional callback `function(state, current_node)`. output Output mode: - `"agent"` (default): return runnable agent, - `"mermaid"`: return Mermaid text, - `""`: return list `run`, `graph`, `mermaid`. direction Mermaid direction `output` includes Mermaid. subgraphs Optional Mermaid subgraph groups. `NULL`, defaults `list(Supervisor = "supervisor", Workers = names(workers))`. style Logical; include default Mermaid class styling.

title: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
text: - `output = "agent"`: runnable function(state). - `output = "mermaid"`: Mermaid text. - `output = ""`: list `run`, `graph`, `mermaid`.

title: Build a Custom Multi-Agent Team (Supervisor Style) — build_custom_multi_agent
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ supervisor_fn <- function(state) {   if (is.null(state$turn) || state$turn == 0) "Researcher" else "FINISH" }  workers <- list(   Researcher = function(state) {     list(result = "Research complete")   },   Writer = function(state) {     list(result = "Draft complete")   } )  team <- build_custom_multi_agent(   supervisor = supervisor_fn,   workers = workers,   output = "both" )  cat(team$mermaid) team$run(list()) } # }

title: LLMAgentR 0.3.1 (Upcoming Release - February 2026)
text: Custom Agent Builder API Added build_custom_agent() creating user-defined graph/state-machine agents custom node functions, static edges, conditional edges. Exported State-Graph Primitives Exported StateGraph(), make_node(), make_edge(), make_command(), interrupt() support custom workflow construction. LangGraph-Style Mermaid Export Added compile_graph() as_mermaid() Mermaid visualization, including optional subgraph grouping graph direction control. PNG Graph Export Utility Added save_mermaid_png() render Mermaid graph text (compiled graph objects) PNG files via Mermaid CLI (mmdc). Reusable Code Agent Builder Pattern build_code_agent() function now supports builder pattern. user_input omitted, function returns reusable agent (closure) can handle multiple queries interactively. allows flexible integration iterative coding workflows, similar existing build_researcher_agent(). Reusable Interpreter Agent build_interpreter_agent() function now also supports builder pattern. code_output omitted, returns reusable interpreter function can process multiple outputs (tables, model results, charts, etc.) demand. provides consistent interface explaining analysis results dynamically.
